_crawl.about: Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) is a products, services, and technology platforms company for healthcare customers. With more than 25,000 Team Schein Members worldwide, the Company's network of trusted advisors provides more than 1 million customers globally with more than 300 valued solutions that help improve operational success and clinical outcomes. Our Business, Clinical, Technology, and Supply Chain solutions help office-based dental and medical practitioners work more efficiently so they can provide quality care more effectively. These solutions also support dental laboratories, government and institutional healthcare clinics, as well as other alternate care sites. Henry Schein operates through a centralized and automated distribution network, with a selection of more than 300,000 branded products and Henry Schein corporate brand products in our distribution centers. A FORTUNE 500 Company and a member of the S&P 500® index, Henry Schein is headquartered in Melville, N.Y., and has operations or affiliates in 34 countries and territories. The Company's sales reached $13.2 billion in 2025, and have grown at a compound annual rate of approximately 11.0 percent since Henry Schein became a public company in 1995.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

##### [Peripheral Arterial Disease][33]

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD), also known as peripheral vascular disease (PVD), is a common
circulatory problem in which narrowed arteries reduce blood flow to the limbs, typically the legs.
PAD is primarily caused by atherosclerosis, a condition where fatty deposits (plaque) build up
inside the arteries.

[View More ][34]

##### [Diabetic Foot and Limb Salvage][35]

Diabetic foot complications and limb salvage are critical aspects of diabetes management,
particularly for individuals who have developed complications due to Peripheral Arterial Disease
(PAD) and Diabetic Foot Ulcers (DFUs). Diabetes can lead to nerve damage (neuropathy) and poor blood
circulation (PAD).

[View More ][36]

##### [Varicose Veins and Ulcer Management][37]

Varicose veins are enlarged, swollen, and twisted veins that typically occur in the legs and feet.
They develop when the valves within the veins that help regulate blood flow become weakened or
damaged, causing blood to pool and the veins to stretch. Over time, this can lead to various
complications, including venous ulcers.

[View More ][38]

##### [Dialysis Access – Fistula and Graft][39]

Dialysis access is a critical aspect of the treatment for individuals with end-stage renal disease
(ESRD) who require hemodialysis. Hemodialysis is a medical procedure that filters waste products and
excess fluids from the blood. To facilitate hemodialysis, a reliable access point to the bloodstream
is necessary.

[View More ][40]

##### [Vascular screening services][41]

Vascular screening services are medical examinations or tests that are specifically designed to
assess the health of the blood vessels and identify any potential abnormalities or risk factors.
This is particularly important for individuals with risk factors for vascular diseases, such as
older age, smoking, high blood pressure, diabetes, and a family history of vascular problems.

[View More ][42]

##### [Noninvasive Angiography of Peripheral Arteries][43]

Noninvasive angiography of peripheral arteries, used to visualize and assess the blood vessels in
the arms and legs without the need for invasive procedures. These techniques provide valuable
information about the health and integrity of the peripheral arterial system and help in the
diagnosis and management of various vascular conditions.

[View More ][44]

(ESRD) who require hemodialysis. Hemodialysis is a medical procedure that filters waste products and
excess fluids from the blood. To facilitate hemodialysis, a reliable access point to the bloodstream
is necessary.

[View More ][40]

##### [Vascular screening services][41]

Vascular screening services are medical examinations or tests that are specifically designed to
assess the health of the blood vessels and identify any potential abnormalities or risk factors.
This is particularly important for individuals with risk factors for vascular diseases, such as
older age, smoking, high blood pressure, diabetes, and a family history of vascular problems.

[View More ][42]

##### [Noninvasive Angiography of Peripheral Arteries][43]

Noninvasive angiography of peripheral arteries, used to visualize and assess the blood vessels in
the arms and legs without the need for invasive procedures. These techniques provide valuable
information about the health and integrity of the peripheral arterial system and help in the
diagnosis and management of various vascular conditions.

[View More ][44]

##### [Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair][45]

Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) repair is a surgical procedure performed to treat an aneurysm—a
bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that carries blood from the heart
to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and may lead to a rupture, which
is a life-threatening medical emergency.

[View More ][46]

##### [Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage][47]

Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage refers to procedures and interventions aimed at
preserving and restoring the functionality of an existing dialysis access (e.g., fistula or graft)
that may be experiencing complications or dysfunction. These minimally invasive techniques are
designed to avoid the need for major surgeries, reduce patient discomfort.

[View More ][48]

##### [Carotid Disease Management and Surgery for Stroke][49]

Carotid disease management and surgery play a crucial role in preventing strokes caused by carotid
artery stenosis, a condition where the carotid arteries, the major arteries in the neck supplying
blood to the brain, become narrowed or blocked due to atherosclerosis. Carotid artery disease is a
significant risk factor for ischemic strokes.

[View More ][50]

##### [Catheter Based Angioplasty and Stenting][51]

Catheter-based angioplasty and stenting are minimally invasive procedures used to treat narrow or
blocked blood vessels, typically arteries. These procedures are commonly performed in various parts
of the body, such as the heart (coronary arteries), legs (peripheral arteries), neck (carotid
arteries), and kidneys (renal arteries).

[View More ][52]

in the body. While they have different causes and characteristics, both conditions can lead to
significant health issues.Traumatic vascular injuries can range from mild contusions or bruises to
severe lacerations or disruptions of blood vessels.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

## Aortic Disease: The Patient Guide
## [Free Download][25] | YouTube Playlist

 

This guide is here to help you and your loved ones understand what comes next after a diagnosis of
aortic disease. Every journey is unique—shaped by the type of condition, timing of diagnosis, and
overall health. That’s why personalized care and informed decisions are so important.


We know this can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to absorb everything at once. Think of this
guide as a map—explore the parts that matter most to you right now.


For families and caregivers, your support is invaluable. Whether helping manage appointments or
offering a listening ear, your patience and understanding make a powerful difference.


You are not alone on this journey—we’re here to walk it with you.

## Aortic Dissection: The Patient Guide
## [Free Download][30] | [YouTube Playlist][31]

 

With a heartfelt thanks to the team at [Aortic Dissection UK & Ireland][32]. Aortic Hope along with
[Think Aorta US][33] are proud to present [Aortic Dissection: The Patient Guide][34]. This guide is
[free for download][35]. There is a [bulk order form][36] as well for the Medical Community to
provide for their patients.

[Think Aorta US][38] se enorgullecen de presentar [Disección aórtica: La Guía del Paciente][39].
Esta guía se puede [descargar gratuitamente][40]. También hay un [formulario de pedido a granel][41]
para que la comunidad médica lo distribuya a sus pacientes.

## Our Impact

 

## 9000+


##### FOLLOWERS AND SUPPORTERS


In addition to a strong online presence, our community outreach is enabling us to expand our mission
globally.

[Aortic HOPE]

 

Since Aortic Hope was founded in 2016, we have provided support to individuals within the community
and we are still growing! Initially, our Hope Mail Care Packages were sent to 30 people and now that
program has grown by almost 400%! Our live educational videos are spanning the globe! We have been
heard over Sirius XM, spoken at Rock from the Heart Symposiums, connected with countries who have
adopted the Think Aorta campaign, and seen on The Donna Drake Show!


 

## 45+

 

##### GLOBAL PRESENCE AND GROWING


Other than the United States, Aortic Hope has reached individuals in Canada, Australia, Sweden, UK,
India, Angola, Kenya, New Zealand and more!


[Aortic HOPE]

 

## 5200+


##### HOSPITAL REACH


 

In collaboration with the non-profit Think Aorta US, Aortic Hope has a presence in over 5200
hospitals in the US!

Our medical experts are among the country’s best in primary care as well as in a wide-range of
medical specialties, including neurosurgery, coronary artery bypass grafting, angioplasty,
minimally-invasive robotic surgery, oncology, and many more.
[ Our Doctors ][71]

We provide the highest quality care and best solutions for our patients by constantly upgrading our
facilities and equipment with the latest medical innovations such as the country’s first Dual
Console da Vinci Xi Robotic Surgical System, the most complete Cancer Institute and Heart Institute,
among others.
[ Learn More ][72]

We know that patients in need of medical care are at their most vulnerable selves, that is why our
fundamental tenet is compassionate care.  All our medical doctors, nursing, and allied health
professionals are committed to providing effective and person-centered care, treating every patient
with empathy and respect.
[ Learn More ][73]

# Statistics thatsave lives

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make
better decisions

### We change lives
### and systems

Two thirds of new World Health Organization guidelines in the past 5 years cite at least 1 Cochrane
review. [Read about our impact][23].

### Our evidence
### is trusted

Scientists, policymakers and decision-makers turn to us for evidence they can rely on. [Learn why
our evidence is trusted][24].

### We collaborate
### globally

We produce outstanding evidence by collaborating with a wide range of experts and members of the
public. [Get involved][25].

  A new Cochrane review finds that exercise may improve pain and function, but the benefits may fall
  short of what patients would notice in daily life.
* [ ][29]
  
  [Why evidence synthesis matters in the age of AI][30]
  
  22 July 2026
  
  In an era defined by an abundance of information, and new ways to find it, Cochrane’s Chief
  Executive Officer, Karla Soares-Weiser argues that systematic reviews remain an essential tool to
  help individuals, healthcare professionals and policymakers make decisions. However, the challenge
  is no longer simply producing reliable evidence but maintaining the trust that makes Cochrane’s
  evidence useful.

  Knowledge translation (KT) is a key part of ensuring that high-quality evidence reaches the people
  who can use it. In Italy, however, research methods and evidence-based medicine (EBM) are not
  consistently integrated into higher education or medical education programmes.

  Centre’.

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD), also known as peripheral vascular disease (PVD), is a common
circulatory problem in which narrowed arteries reduce blood flow to the limbs, typically the legs.
PAD is primarily caused by atherosclerosis, a condition where fatty deposits (plaque) build up
inside the arteries.

##### [Diabetic Foot and Limb Salvage][35]

Diabetic foot complications and limb salvage are critical aspects of diabetes management,
particularly for individuals who have developed complications due to Peripheral Arterial Disease
(PAD) and Diabetic Foot Ulcers (DFUs). Diabetes can lead to nerve damage (neuropathy) and poor blood
circulation (PAD).

[View More ][36]

##### [Varicose Veins and Ulcer Management][37]

Varicose veins are enlarged, swollen, and twisted veins that typically occur in the legs and feet.
They develop when the valves within the veins that help regulate blood flow become weakened or
damaged, causing blood to pool and the veins to stretch. Over time, this can lead to various
complications, including venous ulcers.

[View More ][38]

Dialysis access is a critical aspect of the treatment for individuals with end-stage renal disease
(ESRD) who require hemodialysis. Hemodialysis is a medical procedure that filters waste products and
excess fluids from the blood. To facilitate hemodialysis, a reliable access point to the bloodstream
is necessary.

Vascular screening services are medical examinations or tests that are specifically designed to
assess the health of the blood vessels and identify any potential abnormalities or risk factors.

bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that carries blood from the heart
to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and may lead to a rupture, which
is a life-threatening medical emergency.

Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage refers to procedures and interventions aimed at
preserving and restoring the functionality of an existing dialysis access (e.g., fistula or graft)

designed to avoid the need for major surgeries, reduce patient discomfort.

[View More ][48]

##### [Carotid Disease Management and Surgery for Stroke][49]

Carotid disease management and surgery play a crucial role in preventing strokes caused by carotid
artery stenosis, a condition where the carotid arteries, the major arteries in the neck supplying
blood to the brain, become narrowed or blocked due to atherosclerosis. Carotid artery disease is a
significant risk factor for ischemic strokes.

[View More ][50]

##### [Catheter Based Angioplasty and Stenting][51]

Catheter-based angioplasty and stenting are minimally invasive procedures used to treat narrow or
blocked blood vessels, typically arteries. These procedures are commonly performed in various parts
of the body, such as the heart (coronary arteries), legs (peripheral arteries), neck (carotid
arteries), and kidneys (renal arteries).

[View More ][52]

in the body. While they have different causes and characteristics, both conditions can lead to
significant health issues.Traumatic vascular injuries can range from mild contusions or bruises to
severe lacerations or disruptions of blood vessels.

## Your questions, answered

### [ Want to see more FAQs? Click here to explore the full list ][59]

I forgot my password, will I be able to recover my account?

Yes, of course. If you are a patient using the app the easiest way to recover your account would be
to reset your password using the patient app, or on the Healthera Connect Platform if you are a
pharmacist. If you get stuck please email us at [support@healthera.co.uk][60]

I am not in the UK, can I use Healthera?
Healthera is currently not available outside of the UK. However, Healthera is expanding rapidly and
there are plans to bring the app to other countries in the near future – so stay tuned!
I wish to make a complaint

As a healthcare provider and representative of your community pharmacies, Healthera takes complaints
and feedback seriously. If you wish to make a complaint or give us some feedback please do so by
emailing [support@healthera.co.uk][61] and include either ‘Feedback’ or ‘Complaint’ in the subject
line.

How does Healthera make money?
We charge a monthly subscription fee for pharmacies who would like to use Healthera. This allows
pharmacies to offer the mobile app to their patients for free.
What if my pharmacy is not currently a Healthera pharmacy?

We are working to bring as many pharmacies on board with Healthera as possible, but this may take a
little time. Please email us at [support@healthera.co.uk][62] to let us know your pharmacy’s name
and their contact details so our team can approach them.

# **Welcome to Chennai Vascular Surgeon:**

Welcome to the website for the Division of Vascular Surgery and the Center for Treatment of Vascular
Disease at Apollo Hospital,Chennai. The Center is dedicated to the comprehensive understanding and
treatment of vascular diseases, as it affects arteries, veins and lymphatics. The Center has three
primary goals, the most important of which is prevention and treatment of vascular disease. We are
staffed by a team composed of board certified vascular surgeons and endovascular specialists, a
vascular internist, and assisted by a group of Vascular Nurse Specialists, Nurse Practitioners,
Physicians Assistants and nutritionists. Dr. V. Balaji, MS.,FRCS[Eng]., FRCS[Edin]., FRCS[Gen].,
FICS. He was born in the year 1963 and had is undergraduate medical education at Madras Medical
College Chennai. He graduated in the year 1986 and joined post graduate surgical training
immediately at Madras Medical College and Government General Hospital Chennai. He passed out in 1989
and left for United Kingdom for further higher surgical training. He obtained FRCS from Royal
college of Surgeons of England in 1989 and FRCS from Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in1990.
In 1997 he was first overseas candidate to obtain FRCS from Inter Collegiate Board of Royal
Colleges. In the same year in recognition of his excellent academic performance he was elected
Fellow of International College of Surgeons by the European Section of the college.

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

marketing

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,

email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Our Vision:To Transform Lives by Revolutionizing Treatment of Aneurysmal Disease

## Nectero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company pioneering novel therapies with a
## potential to treat aneurysmal disease and improve patients’ lives.

The company is led by a highly accomplished, multidisciplinary management team with input from an
experienced board of directors and renowned physician leaders in vascular surgery and interventions.
[Learn More][19]

Abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) represent a significant public health concern:
* Current surgical or endovascular treatments are reserved for AAA larger than 5.5cm (5.0cm in
  women) in diameter, in symptomatic patients, or in rapidly expanding aneurysms
* Smaller AAAs are traditionally monitored with serial ultrasound or computed tomography (CT)
  surveillance

[Learn More][20]

## Nectero Therapeutics is developing an investigational treatment with the potential to stabilize
## growth and minimize risk of rupture of small to mid-sized AAA

Nectero Endovascular Aneurysm Stabilization Treatment (Nectero EAST^{®}) System uses an endovascular
approach to deliver a proprietary mixture to the site of the aneurysm.

Treatment with the Nectero EAST^{®} System may prevent or significantly delay the need for major
intervention. By minimizing further degradation of the aneurysm and strengthening the aortic tissue
around the aneurysm, many patients can live out their normal life span and never need to face the
challenges of endovascular repair (EVAR) or open surgery to address their aneurysm. [Learn More][21]

# Welcome to Northeast Georgia Physicians Group

**Northeast Georgia Physicians Group (NGPG)** brings together over 700 talented physicians,
physician assistants, nurse practitioners, midwives and other clinical staff at more than 50
locations across North Georgia. As the state’s sixth-largest physician group, we always have a
practice nearby to offer you expert care in more than 40 specialties.

NGPG is affiliated with [Northeast Georgia Health System (NGHS)][60], a non-profit which serves more
than 1 million people in 19 counties across the region. As part of NGHS, patients of NGPG have a
direct connection to Northeast Georgia Medical Center’s seven hospitals in Gainesville, Braselton,
Winder, Dahlonega and Demorest.

## The Medical AI Behind Your Report

ReadYourLab is powered by purpose-built medical AI models — not general-purpose chatbots. Every scan
report and document analysis is generated by models specifically trained on medical imaging and
clinical data.

### Google MedGemma 1.5

CT & MRI Scan Analysis

Your [CT scan][43] & [MRI scan][44] are evaluated by **MedGemma 1.5 from Google Research**. This is
a specialized 4-billion-parameter medical AI built on Gemma 3, with a medically-tuned vision encoder
(MedSigLIP) trained on de-identified medical imaging data. It reviews every slice of your scan as a
complete 3D volume — just like a radiologist would.
* Full 3D volumetric analysis of CT and MRI DICOM series
* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

[ MedGemma capabilities & limitations ][45]

### OpenAI GPT

Medical Q&A & Document Analysis

Your medical questions, radiology reports, and clinical notes are evaluated by **OpenAI's GPT**. GPT
handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

[ Read more about GPT ][46]

### How We Use AI Responsibly

Transparency is central to how we operate. Here's what you should know about our AI analysis.

#### Open Benchmarks, No Black Box

MedGemma 1.5 is published and peer-reviewed with full benchmark data on [arXiv][47] and Google's
[model card][48]. We disclose exactly what the AI can and cannot do. For more details, see the
[MedGemma Technical Report][49] (Sellergren et al., 2025).

#### Informational, Not Diagnostic

ReadYourLab provides an AI-generated plain-language walk-through of your images to help you
understand your scan before or after your doctor's appointment. It is **not a substitute for a
licensed radiologist or physician**. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
[AI vs. Radiologist — honest comparison][50].

#### Your Data Stays Private

Your scans are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your medical data with third
parties. You can delete all your data with a single click at any time. HIPAA- and GDP [Skip to main content][1]

* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

[ MedGemma capabilities & limitations ][45]

### OpenAI GPT

Medical Q&A & Document Analysis

Your medical questions, radiology reports, and clinical notes are evaluated by **OpenAI's GPT**. GPT
handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

[ Read more about GPT ][46]

### How We Use AI Responsibly

Transparency is central to how we operate. Here's what you should know about our AI analysis.

#### Open Benchmarks, No Black Box

MedGemma 1.5 is published and peer-reviewed with full benchmark data on [arXiv][47] and Google's
[model card][48]. We disclose exactly what the AI can and cannot do. For more details, see the
[MedGemma Technical Report][49] (Sellergren et al., 2025).

#### Informational, Not Diagnostic

ReadYourLab provides an AI-generated plain-language walk-through of your images to help you
understand your scan before or after your doctor's appointment. It is **not a substitute for a
licensed radiologist or physician**. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
[AI vs. Radiologist — honest comparison][50].

#### Your Data Stays Private

Your scans are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your medical data with third
parties. You can delete all your data with a single click at any time. HIPAA- and GDPR-aligned
practices. [Read our data security policy][51].

### Meet the Founders

[Dr. Zoltán Nyárády, Co-Founder and Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon at ReadYourLab]

Dr. Zoltán Nyárády

Co-Founder · Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

MD, DMD, PhD

My specialty is oral surgery, dental implantation, and minimally invasive oral surgical procedures.

The greatest reward for me is when patients who once feared the dentist, oral surgeon, or implant
procedures come back smiling for follow-up care — knowing I was able to ease their anxiety and show
them that dental and oral surgery can be truly painless.

[ Read full bio ][52]
[Peter Nemeth, Co-Founder of ReadYourLab]

Peter Nemeth

Co-Founder

I spent most of my career building enterprise software products at ServiceNow, HP, and IBM. After a
cancer diagnosis, I remember staring at a grey CT scan and feeling completely lost — with no idea
what I was looking at. Using AI to finally understand what was happening in my own body was
transformational.

I built ReadYourLab to give everyone access to the tool I wish I'd had during this time.

[ Read full bio ][53]

## Our Mission

ReadYourLab makes state-of-the-art medical AI accessible to patients. We believe every patient
deserves the ability to view and understand their own scans.

We believe the best way to make medical imaging more useful is to put it directly in the hands of
patients. We want patients to be able to view, use, and understand their data in ways the
traditional healthcare system simply doesn't allow. Patients should be able to decide how to engage
with their own health and take control of their care in collaboration with their doctors.

AI-powered tools for explaining and visualizing the human body are a powerful way to give patients
the freedom of information and medical education they deserve.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

## About Us

South Valley Vascular opened in 2005 and now has 4 offices in Central Valley.

At South Valley Vascular, we focus on more than just treatment — we prioritize your overall
experience. From the moment you walk through our doors, our goal is to offer efficient, effective
care in a calm, welcoming setting. Our team of board-certified, fellowship-trained surgeons brings
extensive expertise in vascular surgery and minimally invasive procedures, using the latest
techniques and technology to deliver excellent outcomes. Recognized throughout the Central Valley,
our surgeons are trusted by both patients and referring physicians alike. We’ve built a team that
shares our commitment to compassionate, detail-oriented care — because we believe the best results
start with the best experience. Have a question? Reach out anytime — our knowledgeable, friendly
staff is always here to help.

## What We Do

Vascular surgeons treat a wide range of diseases and conditions aﬀecting the arteries and veins,
specifically focusing on the circulatory system outside of the heart and brain.

Our Treatments

affected by varicosity. They are a cosmetic issue and may become a medical issue.

PAD is a disease of the arteries of the legs. It is common, affecting 20% of people over the age of
65. When blood vessels in the legs become blocked with fatty deposits circulation is obstructed.

Carotid artery disease is atherosclerosis (hardening of the arteries) causing the carotid arteries
to narrow or become blocked, which may cause a stroke. This is a serious, life-threatening

makes life-saving dialysis possible. A vascular surgeon surgically creates an arteriovenous fistula
to allow the body to remove and return blood during dialysis.

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by

standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Redefining the Standard of Care for Aortic Aneurysm Treatment

Taurus Vascular is a Houston-based medical device company focused on improving long-term outcomes
for patients with aortic aneurysms.

[ Get in Touch ][11]

## The Standard of Care

Each year, over one million people are diagnosed with an abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA), which is a
bulging, dilation or ballooning in the wall of a blood vessel. If left untreated, an aneurysm can
rupture and result in sudden, severe bleeding - just as a balloon will burst when inflated beyond
its capacity.

Survival after aortic aneurysm rupture is less than 20%. Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is the
current standard of care for treating AAAs. It involves inserting a stent graft into the site of the
aneurysm through a small incision in the groin. It is positioned and expanded to support the
weakened artery walls and reduce the risk of rupture.

### Globally, there are over 250,000 EVAR procedures performed each year, representing a $3.2B
### market.

## The Challenge

Despite the success of EVAR in reducing mortality rates and improving patient outcomes, endoleaks
remain a major issue, impacting up to 50% of patients. Endoleak is a common and serious complication
that occurs when blood leaks back into the aneurysm sac, which can cause the aneurysm to continue to
grow and potentially rupture. In fact, up to 20% of patients who undergo EVAR require a repeat
procedure within 5 years due to endoleaks. This high rate of reintervention can result in
significant healthcare spending, with over $1.5B added to the U.S. healthcare system each year.
Given the high incidence of endoleaks and their associated risks, there is a critical need to find
effective solutions to mitigate this complication and improve patient outcomes following EVAR.

## The Solution

Our minimally-invasive, catheter-based technology places a self-deploying stent between the
high-pressure aneurysm sac and low-pressure nearby vein, allowing for the continuous drainage of
endoleaks and depressurization of the aneurysmal sac following EVAR. Representing a significant
improvement over the current standard of care for abdominal aortic aneurysm treatment, our
technology aims to improve procedure outcomes and allow patients to live longer, healthier lives
after abdominal aortic aneurysm repair.

# **1 Sperm + 1 Egg= 1 New Miraculous  Life **                                                    
                                                                                                  
# **Conception and the Spark of a New Life and Soul**                                             
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The most miraculous event in all of human biology, within the grasp of all human experience, is
conception.

Two cells meet and bond at the right place at the right time and a new life is created.  Most the
time things go well, but sometimes they do not.

This event gives us insight into all other happenings in life. Two parts connect and bond at the
right place and the right time, creating a new whole ….  and here starts our story.

### And in the living world similar events are taking place in and all around us

### The thinking of the Common Vein is best described by

### Archilogus
### and his quote about
### The Fox and the Hedgehog

 


Isaiah Berlin expanded the sentence into an essay expressing the concept of the differences between
centripetal and centrifugal thought and approach to the events in the world

### The Pursuit of Oneness is both
### Conscious and Unconscious


If things are good then there is order and health, and if things are bad there is disorder and
disease.

#### Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down or Somewhere in Between



It is our purpose in life to find the disorder and try and bring it back to order.  It is called
Tikun Olam in Jewish culture – or  “healing the world”.

This is not only the beginning but also the end of the story of The Common Vein..

#### [BIOGRAPHY][163]

This web site reflects the  philosophical, educational, and artistic pursuits of Ashley Davidoff MD,
a resident of Newton Massachusetts.

The essence of the work revolves around the concept that the whole is bigger than its component
parts.

The program encompasses a multidisciplinary approach  including biology, medicine, art, photography,
music, poetry and gardening  to exemplify the unifying principles that govern the complexity of life
in and around us.

information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

подозрительную активность в режиме реального времени.

Обученные операторы активируют динамики при появлении нежелательных лиц или нарушителей, которые
обычно убегают с вашей собственности, так как не подозревают, что за ними наблюдают!

Оператор звонит в полицию, сообщая о преступниках в прямом эфире, ДО того, как они проникнут внутрь
или нанесут ущерб.

Устали от самостоятельного поиска видео, в системе видеонаблюдения, когда что- либо уже произошло ?

подозрительную активность в режиме реального времени.

обычно убегают с вашей собственности, так как не подозревают, что за ними наблюдают!

  видеомониторинга.
* В отличии от охранника- наш центр мониторинга никогда не спит.

* Даже если вы находитесь за 1000 км от центра мониторинга- он вам поможет. Расстояние не преграда.

aortic disease. Every journey is unique—shaped by the type of condition, timing of diagnosis, and
overall health. That’s why personalized care and informed decisions are so important.


We know this can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to absorb everything at once. Think of this
guide as a map—explore the parts that matter most to you right now.

with empathy and respect.

# Statistics thatsave lives

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make
better decisions

### We change lives
### and systems

Two thirds of new World Health Organization guidelines in the past 5 years cite at least 1 Cochrane
review. [Read about our impact][23].

### Our evidence
### is trusted

Scientists, policymakers and decision-makers turn to us for evidence they can rely on. [Learn why
our evidence is trusted][24].

### We collaborate
### globally

We produce outstanding evidence by collaborating with a wide range of experts and members of the
public. [Get involved][25].

## [News][26]
* [ ][27]
  
  [Exercise helps hip arthritis pain, but perhaps less than we thought][28]
  
  23 July 2026
  
  A new Cochrane review finds that exercise may improve pain and function, but the benefits may fall
  short of what patients would notice in daily life.
* [ ][29]
  
  [Why evidence synthesis matters in the age of AI][30]
  
  22 July 2026
  
  In an era defined by an abundance of information, and new ways to find it, Cochrane’s Chief
  Executive Officer, Karla Soares-Weiser argues that systematic reviews remain an essential tool to
  help individuals, healthcare professionals and policymakers make decisions. However, the challenge
  is no longer simply producing reliable evidence but maintaining the trust that makes Cochrane’s
  evidence useful.
* [ ][31]
  
  [Building a volunteer network through Cochrane Engage][32]
  
  16 July 2026
  
  Knowledge translation (KT) is a key part of ensuring that high-quality evidence reaches the people
  who can use it. In Italy, however, research methods and evidence-based medicine (EBM) are not
  consistently integrated into higher education or medical education programmes.
* [ ][33]
  
  [World Evidence-based Healthcare Day launches its 2026 campaign][34]
  
  24 June 2026
  
  Today an international coalition of organizations dedicated to evidence-informed decision-making
  launched the World Evidence-based Healthcare Day 2026 campaign, ‘Evidence and AI: People at the
  Centre’.

[More news][35]

the highest quality clinical evidence will always be our north star.

breast cancer (mBC).

## Your questions, answered

### [ Want to see more FAQs? Click here to explore the full list ][59]

I forgot my password, will I be able to recover my account?

Yes, of course. If you are a patient using the app the easiest way to recover your account would be
to reset your password using the patient app, or on the Healthera Connect Platform if you are a
pharmacist. If you get stuck please email us at [support@healthera.co.uk][60]

I am not in the UK, can I use Healthera?
Healthera is currently not available outside of the UK. However, Healthera is expanding rapidly and
there are plans to bring the app to other countries in the near future – so stay tuned!
I wish to make a complaint

As a healthcare provider and representative of your community pharmacies, Healthera takes complaints
and feedback seriously. If you wish to make a complaint or give us some feedback please do so by
emailing [support@healthera.co.uk][61] and include either ‘Feedback’ or ‘Complaint’ in the subject
line.

How does Healthera make money?
We charge a monthly subscription fee for pharmacies who would like to use Healthera. This allows
pharmacies to offer the mobile app to their patients for free.
What if my pharmacy is not currently a Healthera pharmacy?

We are working to bring as many pharmacies on board with Healthera as possible, but this may take a
little time. Please email us at [support@healthera.co.uk][62] to let us know your pharmacy’s name
and their contact details so our team can approach them.

# **Welcome to Chennai Vascular Surgeon:**

Welcome to the website for the Division of Vascular Surgery and the Center for Treatment of Vascular
Disease at Apollo Hospital,Chennai. The Center is dedicated to the comprehensive understanding and
treatment of vascular diseases, as it affects arteries, veins and lymphatics. The Center has three
primary goals, the most important of which is prevention and treatment of vascular disease. We are
staffed by a team composed of board certified vascular surgeons and endovascular specialists, a
vascular internist, and assisted by a group of Vascular Nurse Specialists, Nurse Practitioners,
Physicians Assistants and nutritionists. Dr. V. Balaji, MS.,FRCS[Eng]., FRCS[Edin]., FRCS[Gen].,
FICS. He was born in the year 1963 and had is undergraduate medical education at Madras Medical
College Chennai. He graduated in the year 1986 and joined post graduate surgical training
immediately at Madras Medical College and Government General Hospital Chennai. He passed out in 1989
and left for United Kingdom for further higher surgical training. He obtained FRCS from Royal
college of Surgeons of England in 1989 and FRCS from Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in1990.
In 1997 he was first overseas candidate to obtain FRCS from Inter Collegiate Board of Royal
Colleges. In the same year in recognition of his excellent academic performance he was elected
Fellow of International College of Surgeons by the European Section of the college.

subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

## potential to treat aneurysmal disease and improve patients’ lives.

The company is led by a highly accomplished, multidisciplinary management team with input from an
experienced board of directors and renowned physician leaders in vascular surgery and interventions.

Abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) represent a significant public health concern:

  women) in diameter, in symptomatic patients, or in rapidly expanding aneurysms
* Smaller AAAs are traditionally monitored with serial ultrasound or computed tomography (CT)
  surveillance

## Nectero Therapeutics is developing an investigational treatment with the potential to stabilize
## growth and minimize risk of rupture of small to mid-sized AAA

approach to deliver a proprietary mixture to the site of the aneurysm.

intervention. By minimizing further degradation of the aneurysm and strengthening the aortic tissue
around the aneurysm, many patients can live out their normal life span and never need to face the
challenges of endovascular repair (EVAR) or open surgery to address their aneurysm. [Learn More][21]

## The Medical AI Behind Your Report

ReadYourLab is powered by purpose-built medical AI models — not general-purpose chatbots. Every scan
report and document analysis is generated by models specifically trained on medical imaging and
clinical data.

### Google MedGemma 1.5

CT & MRI Scan Analysis

Your [CT scan][43] & [MRI scan][44] are evaluated by **MedGemma 1.5 from Google Research**. This is
a specialized 4-billion-parameter medical AI built on Gemma 3, with a medically-tuned vision encoder
(MedSigLIP) trained on de-identified medical imaging data. It reviews every slice of your scan as a
complete 3D volume — just like a radiologist would.
* Full 3D volumetric analysis of CT and MRI DICOM series
* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

[ MedGemma capabilities & limitations ][45]

### OpenAI GPT

Medical Q&A & Document Analysis

Your medical questions, radiology reports, and clinical notes are evaluated by **OpenAI's GPT**. GPT
handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

[ Read more about GPT ][46]

### How We Use AI Responsibly

Transparency is central to how we operate. Here's what you should know about our AI analysis.

#### Open Benchmarks, No Black Box

MedGemma 1.5 is published and peer-reviewed with full benchmark data on [arXiv][47] and Google's
[model card][48]. We disclose exactly what the AI can and cannot do. For more details, see the
[MedGemma Technical Report][49] (Sellergren et al., 2025).

#### Informational, Not Diagnostic

ReadYourLab provides an AI-generated plain-language walk-through of your images to help you
understand your scan before or after your doctor's appointment. It is **not a substitute for a
licensed radiologist or physician**. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
[AI vs. Radiologist — honest comparison][50].

ReadYourLab is powered by purpose-built medical AI models — not general-purpose chatbots. Every scan
report and document analysis is generated by models specifically trained on medical imaging and
clinical data.

### Google MedGemma 1.5

CT & MRI Scan Analysis

Your [CT scan][43] & [MRI scan][44] are evaluated by **MedGemma 1.5 from Google Research**. This is
a specialized 4-billion-parameter medical AI built on Gemma 3, with a medically-tuned vision encoder
(MedSigLIP) trained on de-identified medical imaging data. It reviews every slice of your scan as a
complete 3D volume — just like a radiologist would.
* Full 3D volumetric analysis of CT and MRI DICOM series
* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

[ MedGemma capabilities & limitations ][45]

### OpenAI GPT

Medical Q&A & Document Analysis

Your medical questions, radiology reports, and clinical notes are evaluated by **OpenAI's GPT**. GPT
handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

[ Read more about GPT ][46]

### How We Use AI Responsibly

Transparency is central to how we operate. Here's what you should know about our AI analysis.

#### Open Benchmarks, No Black Box

MedGemma 1.5 is published and peer-reviewed with full benchmark data on [arXiv][47] and Google's
[model card][48]. We disclose exactly what the AI can and cannot do. For more details, see the
[MedGemma Technical Report][49] (Sellergren et al., 2025).

#### Informational, Not Diagnostic

ReadYourLab provides an AI-generated plain-language walk-through of your images to help you
understand your scan before or after your doctor's appointment. It is **not a substitute for a
licensed radiologist or physician**. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
[AI vs. Radiologist — honest comparison][50].

#### Your Data Stays Private

Your scans are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your medical data with third
parties. You can delete all your data with a single click at any time. HIPAA- and GDPR-aligned
practices. [Read our data security policy][51].

[Dr. Zoltán Nyárády, Co-Founder and Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon at ReadYourLab]

Dr. Zoltán Nyárády

Co-Founder · Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

MD, DMD, PhD

My specialty is oral surgery, dental implantation, and minimally invasive oral surgical procedures.

them that dental and oral surgery can be truly painless.

Peter Nemeth

I spent most of my career building enterprise software products at ServiceNow, HP, and IBM. After a

what I was looking at. Using AI to finally understand what was happening in my own body was
transformational.

deserves the ability to view and understand their own scans.

We believe the best way to make medical imaging more useful is to put it directly in the hands of
patients. We want patients to be able to view, use, and understand their data in ways the
traditional healthcare system simply doesn't allow. Patients should be able to decide how to engage
with their own health and take control of their care in collaboration with their doctors.

AI-powered tools for explaining and visualizing the human body are a powerful way to give patients
the freedom of information and medical education they deserve.

## About Us

South Valley Vascular opened in 2005 and now has 4 offices in Central Valley.

At South Valley Vascular, we focus on more than just treatment — we prioritize your overall
experience. From the moment you walk through our doors, our goal is to offer efficient, effective
care in a calm, welcoming setting. Our team of board-certified, fellowship-trained surgeons brings
extensive expertise in vascular surgery and minimally invasive procedures, using the latest
techniques and technology to deliver excellent outcomes. Recognized throughout the Central Valley,
our surgeons are trusted by both patients and referring physicians alike. We’ve built a team that
shares our commitment to compassionate, detail-oriented care — because we believe the best results
start with the best experience. Have a question? Reach out anytime — our knowledgeable, friendly
staff is always here to help.

## What We Do

Vascular surgeons treat a wide range of diseases and conditions aﬀecting the arteries and veins,
specifically focusing on the circulatory system outside of the heart and brain.

potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Redefining the Standard of Care for Aortic Aneurysm Treatment

Taurus Vascular is a Houston-based medical device company focused on improving long-term outcomes
for patients with aortic aneurysms.

[ Get in Touch ][11]

## The Standard of Care

Each year, over one million people are diagnosed with an abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA), which is a
bulging, dilation or ballooning in the wall of a blood vessel. If left untreated, an aneurysm can
rupture and result in sudden, severe bleeding - just as a balloon will burst when inflated beyond
its capacity.

Survival after aortic aneurysm rupture is less than 20%. Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is the
current standard of care for treating AAAs. It involves inserting a stent graft into the site of the
aneurysm through a small incision in the groin. It is positioned and expanded to support the
weakened artery walls and reduce the risk of rupture.

### Globally, there are over 250,000 EVAR procedures performed each year, representing a $3.2B
### market.

## The Challenge

Despite the success of EVAR in reducing mortality rates and improving patient outcomes, endoleaks
remain a major issue, impacting up to 50% of patients. Endoleak is a common and serious complication
that occurs when blood leaks back into the aneurysm sac, which can cause the aneurysm to continue to
grow and potentially rupture. In fact, up to 20% of patients who undergo EVAR require a repeat
procedure within 5 years due to endoleaks. This high rate of reintervention can result in
significant healthcare spending, with over $1.5B added to the U.S. healthcare system each year.
Given the high incidence of endoleaks and their associated risks, there is a critical need to find
effective solutions to mitigate this complication and improve patient outcomes following EVAR.

## The Solution

Our minimally-invasive, catheter-based technology places a self-deploying stent between the
high-pressure aneurysm sac and low-pressure nearby vein, allowing for the continuous drainage of
endoleaks and depressurization of the aneurysmal sac following EVAR. Representing a significant
improvement over the current standard of care for abdominal aortic aneurysm treatment, our
technology aims to improve procedure outcomes and allow patients to live longer, healthier lives
after abdominal aortic aneurysm repair.

#### [HUMAN REPRODUCTION][161]

 


#### [HUMAN REPRODUCTION][162]

 

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# **1 Sperm + 1 Egg= 1 New Miraculous  Life **                                                    
                                                                                                  
# **Conception and the Spark of a New Life and Soul**                                             
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The most miraculous event in all of human biology, within the grasp of all human experience, is
conception.

Two cells meet and bond at the right place at the right time and a new life is created.  Most the
time things go well, but sometimes they do not.

This event gives us insight into all other happenings in life. Two parts connect and bond at the
right place and the right time, creating a new whole ….  and here starts our story.

### And in the living world similar events are taking place in and all around us

### The thinking of the Common Vein is best described by

### Archilogus
### and his quote about
### The Fox and the Hedgehog

 


Isaiah Berlin expanded the sentence into an essay expressing the concept of the differences between
centripetal and centrifugal thought and approach to the events in the world

### The Pursuit of Oneness is both
### Conscious and Unconscious


If things are good then there is order and health, and if things are bad there is disorder and
disease.

#### Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down or Somewhere in Between



It is our purpose in life to find the disorder and try and bring it back to order.  It is called
Tikun Olam in Jewish culture – or  “healing the world”.

This is not only the beginning but also the end of the story of The Common Vein..

#### [BIOGRAPHY][163]

This web site reflects the  philosophical, educational, and artistic pursuits of Ashley Davidoff MD,
a resident of Newton Massachusetts.

The essence of the work revolves around the concept that the whole is bigger than its component
parts.

The program encompasses a multidisciplinary approach  including biology, medicine, art, photography,
music, poetry and gardening  to exemplify the unifying principles that govern the complexity of life
in and around us.

information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

Сотрудники следят за ключевыми участками вашей собственности, чтобы помочь предотвратить
преступления до того, как они произойдут.

подозрительную активность в режиме реального времени.

Обученные операторы активируют динамики при появлении нежелательных лиц или нарушителей, которые
обычно убегают с вашей собственности, так как не подозревают, что за ними наблюдают!
